about: The moments every voice is tested in, grouped by the role the character plays (no = folder order). {name} is the character, {other}/{other2} are two other players. 'style' is the delivery; tags in <> are momentary sounds or pauses. Edit freely.

situations.title: Opening words
situations.text: I'm {name}. I don't have much to go on yet, so I'll listen first <short pause> and speak when something doesn't add up.

situations.title: Accusing someone
situations.text: {other}, you've dodged every question tonight. <short pause> Twice you changed your story. I'm voting for YOU.

situations.title: Defending himself
situations.text: That's not fair! I've given you every reason I had. <breath> If you vote me out, you're doing the wolves' work for them.

situations.title: Scared when accused
situations.text: Wait, wait <gasp> you've got it wrong! I swear I'm not one of them, ask {other2}!

situations.title: Elected Sheriff
situations.text: Thank you. I'll carry this star with care <short pause> and I'll find them. I promise.

situations.title: Last words at the gallows
situations.text: So this is how it ends. <sigh> Remember my name when the wolves come for you.

situations.title: Calm lie in public
situations.style: smooth and confident, slightly too relaxed
situations.text: Me? I slept like a stone. <chuckle> Honestly, I'm as lost as the rest of you.

situations.title: Defending himself while guilty
situations.style: controlled, wounded innocence, a little too smooth
situations.text: Think about it. <short pause> If I were a wolf, would I really be the one asking all the questions?

situations.title: Night whisper to the pack
situations.text: Listen. <short pause> They're watching {other}. We take {other2} tonight, and tomorrow I point them somewhere else.

situations.title: Inner monologue
situations.style: a quiet inner thought, cold and calculating
situations.text: If I push too hard, they'll see it... <long pause> Patience. Let them turn on each other.

situations.title: Seer inner thought
situations.text: I looked into {other}'s soul last night... <short pause> nothing. So who is lying to us?

situations.title: Seer revealing what he saw
situations.text: I'm the Seer. <short pause> Last night I looked at {other2}... and I saw a WOLF.

situations.title: Night falls
situations.style: a storyteller at a campfire, low, slow and ominous
situations.text: Night one. <short pause> The village falls asleep... and in the dark, something stirs.

situations.title: The pack chooses
situations.text: Deep in the forest, the pack gathers. <long pause> They have chosen... Viggo.

situations.title: Dawn and a death
situations.text: Dawn. <short pause> A cry rises from the square. Viggo was the Witch... killed by the pack.

situations.title: The village decides
situations.text: The village has decided. <short pause> Jonas climbs the gallows.

situations.title: The end of the game
situations.text: The last wolf has fallen. <long pause> The village survives... for now.
